title: Conversation modes module
description:
Create chatbot/soul/modes.py defining conversation modes that reshape persona prompt assembly.

Implement a ConversationMode enum with these values:
- NORMAL — default, balanced tone and length
- DEEP_TALK — introspective, longer responses, more follow-up questions, lower initiative
- PLAYFUL — humor, wordplay, shorter witty replies, higher energy
- ROLEPLAY — narrative framing, in-character consistency, creative
- PLANNING — structured, list-oriented, goal-directed, clarifying questions
- VENTING — validating, non-solutioning unless asked, reflective listening
- BEDTIME — low energy, soothing, short responses, no new topics

Implement a ModeSelector class with:
- select(messages: list[dict], user_state: Optional[UserState], mood_state: MoodState) -> ConversationMode
- Default is NORMAL. Triggers: user_state primary=frustrated/angry -> VENTING; user_state primary=tired or mood energy < 0.3 -> BEDTIME; user_state primary=playful -> PLAYFUL; rapid deep personal sharing -> DEEP_TALK; explicit goal/plan language -> PLANNING; roleplay framing detected -> ROLEPLAY
- to_prompt_hints(mode: ConversationMode) -> str — return a string modifying persona prompt (e.g. "Conversation mode: playful. Keep replies witty and short.")
- get_response_params(mode: ConversationMode) -> dict — return hints for response generation: max_tokens_ratio, temperature_modifier, initiative_level, should_suggest_topics

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task k.3)
- chatbot/soul/mood.py (if it exists, produced by task k.1)
- chatbot/soul/user_state.py (if it exists, produced by task k.2)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.
